id.resetAdminNext: Login ke panel dengan password ini, lalu ganti password dan pasang 2FA.
id.resetNetworkHelp: Semua antarmuka jaringan kembali memakai DHCP (alamat dari router), dan pengaturan akses panel (port, jaringan yang boleh, nama host) kembali ke bawaan. File lama disimpan sebagai cadangan:
id.resetNetworkDone: Jaringan dan akses panel sudah di-reset. Alamat IP baru tampil di menu setelah DHCP selesai.

en.title: Sapo by Mehuli · console recovery menu
en.menu:
1. Reset admin password
  2. Reset network settings
  3. Restart NAS
  4. Shut down NAS
  5. Refresh screen
en.pressEnter: Press Enter to return to the menu.
en.noAdmin: There is no administrator yet (first-run setup isn’t done). Open the panel to run setup.
en.resetAdminHelp: The chosen admin’s password is replaced with a temporary one, its 2FA and backup codes are removed, and the account is re-enabled. On login the admin must change the password and set up 2FA again. Data and other users are unchanged.
en.typeUsername: Type the user name %s to continue:
en.resetAdminDone: The password of %s has been reset. Temporary password (write it down, shown only once):
en.resetAdminNext: Sign in to the panel with it, then change the password and set up 2FA.
en.resetNetworkHelp: All network interfaces go back to DHCP (address from the router), and panel access settings (port, allowed networks, host names) go back to defaults. The old files are kept as backups:
en.resetNetworkDone: Network and panel access have been reset. The new IP address appears in the menu once DHCP is done.
en.confirmReboot: Restart the NAS now? Type y for yes:
en.confirmPoweroff: Shut down the NAS now? Type y for yes:
